code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and increased RDW, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration. There are also monocytosis and basophilia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. Findings warrant urgent clinical evaluation for underlying causes such as infection, hematologic disorder, or systemic disease.
